scene: Inside the warm tea shed, steam curls around clay pots and bubbling jars.
picture: Pixel art interior of a rustic tea shed arranged side-by-side along wooden floorboards. On the far left, the grandfather rests his bicycle near the doorway. On the left, a horned brewer stirs a vat. Three hanging parchment scrolls display tree root diagrams at the centre. On the right, a blue kettle steams on a stone hearth.
shown: A horned baker stirring an amber vat on the left
Three faded plant parchment scrolls hanging at the centre
A bubbling blue ceramic kettle on a counter to the right

variants.scene: Herbal steam rises gently under soft lantern light as a kettle sings warmly.
Golden tea simmers in a big vat while sweet dried herbs hang above.
A cosy hearth crackles softly as you wonder where to find {quest}.
